knowledge:
- key_parameters: features=The second argument of plot_density, specifying a character vector of gene or feature names to visualize ;; joint=Logical parameter; when set to TRUE, returns a joint density plot by multiplying the densities of all query genes ;; combine=Logical parameter; when set to FALSE, returns a list of ggplot objects where the last plot is the joint density estimate, instead of a combined layout
- alternatives: Standard scatter plots using scater::plotUMAP or Seurat's FeaturePlot (with or without order = TRUE), which are preferable for fairly well-expressed genes where dropout is not a major issue
- when_to_use: When visualizing single-cell features (e.g., genes, peaks) that suffer from high dropout rates or sparsity, to recover signal by incorporating cell-to-cell similarity via kernel density estimation
- pitfalls: Using Nebulosa for highly or well-expressed genes where direct visualization is already clear and preferable; relying solely on density plots without comparing to standard clustering results or other core visualization methods

workflows.name: single_cell_experiment_density
workflows.intent: Perform gene-weighted density estimation and visualization on a SingleCellExperiment object.
input: pbmc3k_filtered_gene_bc_matrices.tar.gz (10X Genomics single-cell gene expression matrix)
workflows.stages: 1. Load libraries and import 10X data into a SingleCellExperiment object ;; 2. Pre-process and filter features and cells ;; 3. Normalize data using log-transformation ;; 4. Identify highly variable genes and perform PCA and UMAP dimensionality reduction ;; 5. Cluster cells using SNN graph and Louvain clustering ;; 6. Visualize single-gene density and multi-gene joint density using plot_density
workflows.code:
library("Nebulosa")
library("scater")
library("scran")
library("DropletUtils")
library("BiocFileCache")

bfc <- BiocFileCache(ask = FALSE)
data_file <- bfcrpath(bfc, file.path(
  "https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/10x.files/samples/cell",
  "pbmc3k",
  "pbmc3k_filtered_gene_bc_matrices.tar.gz"
))

untar(data_file, exdir = tempdir())
pbmc <- read10xCounts(file.path(tempdir(),
  "filtered_gene_bc_matrices",
  "hg19"
))

rownames(pbmc) <- uniquifyFeatureNames(rowData(pbmc)[["ID"]],
                                       rowData(pbmc)[["Symbol"]])

i <- rowSums(counts(pbmc) > 0)
is_expressed <- i > 3
pbmc <- pbmc[is_expressed, ]

i <- colSums(counts(pbmc) > 0)
is_expressed <- i > 200
pbmc <- pbmc[,is_expressed]

is_mito <- grepl("^MT-", rownames(pbmc))
qcstats <- perCellQCMetrics(pbmc, subsets = list(Mito = is_mito))
qcfilter <- quickPerCellQC(qcstats, percent_subsets = c("subsets_Mito_percent"))

logcounts(pbmc) <- log1p(counts(pbmc) / colSums(counts(pbmc)) * 1e4)

dec <- modelGeneVar(pbmc)
top_hvgs <- getTopHVGs(dec, n = 3000)

set.seed(66)
pbmc <- runPCA(pbmc, scale = TRUE, subset_row = top_hvgs)

pbmc <- runUMAP(pbmc, dimred = "PCA")

g <- buildSNNGraph(pbmc, k = 10, use.dimred = "PCA")
clust <- igraph::cluster_louvain(g)$membership
colLabels(pbmc) <- factor(clust)

plot_density(pbmc, "CD4")

p3 <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"))
p3 + plot_layout(ncol = 1)

p4 <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"), joint = TRUE)
p4 + plot_layout(ncol = 1)

p_list <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"), joint = TRUE, combine = FALSE)
p_list[[length(p_list)]]

workflows.name: seurat_density
workflows.intent: Perform gene-weighted density estimation and visualization on a Seurat object.
input: pbmc3k_filtered_gene_bc_matrices.tar.gz (10X Genomics single-cell gene expression matrix)
workflows.stages: 1. Load libraries and read 10X data ;; 2. Create a Seurat object and filter cells based on feature counts and mitochondrial gene percentage ;; 3. Normalize data using SCTransform ;; 4. Run PCA and UMAP dimensionality reduction ;; 5. Cluster cells using FindNeighbors and FindClusters ;; 6. Visualize single-gene density and multi-gene joint density using plot_density
workflows.code:
library("Nebulosa")
library("Seurat")
library("BiocFileCache")

bfc <- BiocFileCache(ask = FALSE)
data_file <- bfcrpath(bfc, file.path(
  "https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/10x.files/samples/cell",
  "pbmc3k",
  "pbmc3k_filtered_gene_bc_matrices.tar.gz"
))

untar(data_file, exdir = tempdir())

data <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(tempdir(),
  "filtered_gene_bc_matrices",
  "hg19"
))

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = data,
  project = "pbmc3k",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, verbose = FALSE)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc)

plot_density(pbmc, "CD4")

p3 <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"))
p3 + plot_layout(ncol = 1)

p4 <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"), joint = TRUE)
p4 + plot_layout(ncol = 1)

p_list <- plot_density(pbmc, c("CD8A", "CCR7"), joint = TRUE, combine = FALSE)
p_list[[length(p_list)]]
